glance: CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valuing it at about $43.9 billion, announced alongside strong quarterly results.
Stock futures are bouncing hard after Wall Street's worst week since April 2025: S&P 500 futures up 2-2.6%, Nasdaq 100 futures up nearly 3%.
Treasury Secretary Bessent tied any return of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO to the outcome of probes into chip leakage to China.
Iran vowed to use all available means against the US naval blockade; Rubio meets Qatar's prime minister in Washington today.
Thanksgiving week: markets close Thursday and run a half day Friday; Dell, Workday, HP and Zoom report earnings.

tech.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for about $43.9 billion
tech.summary: CrowdStrike said it will acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal, giving Zscaler holders 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share, and announced it with third-quarter results showing revenue up 28% to $1.58 billion. The merger would unite the leading endpoint-security and cloud-network-security players into one of the largest pure cybersecurity companies. It still needs regulatory approval.

tech.headline: Bessent links any Huang comeback at Nvidia to China chip probes
tech.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said whether Jensen Huang could return as Nvidia CEO should depend on what investigations find about Nvidia chips reaching China; President Trump separately said he would not mind Huang being reinstated. Nvidia, which fell 14% Friday to about $125, faces an SEC disclosure probe and a roughly 10-day deadline for answers from its board.

tech.headline: Anthropic's unusual IPO run chafed some bankers
tech.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic ran its IPO much like SpaceX, tightly limiting the role and fees of its underwriting banks. The stock priced at $83 and began trading Thursday, but fell 8.5% Friday to about $89 as the broader AI selloff deepened.

tech.headline: Amazon's $7.5 billion Decart deal could land this week
tech.summary: Amazon is in advanced talks to buy real-time AI video startup Decart for about $7.5 billion, with an announcement possible this week, according to the Financial Times. It would be one of Amazon's largest AI acquisitions and bolster AWS's own AI compute push.

tech.headline: AI server makers push higher prices onto buyers
tech.summary: Suppliers of AI servers are demanding higher prices from customers as component costs and tight supply bite, the FT reports. That adds cost pressure for cloud providers just as investors question the payoff from AI spending.

tech.headline: AI is speeding up planning of attacks on industrial systems
tech.summary: Security researchers say AI tools are shortening the time it takes attackers to plan intrusions on industrial equipment such as factory and utility controls, according to the FT. Defenders warn that skills once limited to elite state hackers are spreading.

tech.headline: Tesla begins rolling out FSD v15
tech.summary: Tesla started pushing version 15 of its Full Self-Driving software, which Elon Musk promoted as a big step toward fully autonomous driving; it had already been running on Tesla's robotaxi fleet. The supervised system still requires an attentive driver.

markets.asOf: pre-market, Nov 23 (levels are Fri Nov 20 closes; changes are early futures/latest)
markets.summary: Futures are rebounding sharply after last week's AI-led rout pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into correction, helped by thin holiday trading and still-upbeat 2027 forecasts; Asia was mixed, with Korea down and Taiwan up.

other.headline: Iran vows to fight US naval blockade as Rubio meets Qatar
other.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry said it would use all available means against the US naval blockade, calling it military aggression, and summoned Qatar's envoy over a statement condemning Iranian attacks. President Trump said he is inclined to resume strikes after the new year if there is no deal; Secretary of State Rubio meets Qatar's prime minister in Washington today.

other.headline: Fed hike still seen as near-certain for Dec. 9
other.summary: Despite last week's market slide, futures pricing still shows about a 98% chance the Federal Reserve raises rates at its Dec. 9 meeting. The 10-year yield fell to about 4.94% Friday as investors sought safety.

other.headline: Intel chief downplays tech outages ahead of holiday travel
other.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said recent tech outages, including ones touching the FAA and Microsoft, amount to bumps in the road as Thanksgiving travel ramps up.

other.headline: Saudi strike in Yemen's Hodeida reported to kill four
other.summary: Houthi-run media said a Saudi airstrike in the Red Sea port of Hodeida killed four people and wounded 18; Riyadh had not commented. It adds to regional tension tied to the Iran conflict.

other.headline: Dymer strike toll rises as Russia keeps up attacks
other.summary: Ukraine says four people died and about 10 remain missing after a Russian drone hit an apartment block in Dymer near Kyiv over the weekend, while US-led peace talks remain stalled over territory.
